verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Fathom shipping an official MCP *server* so external AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) can pull Fathom's meeting data — the reverse of this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Fathom so its own AI features can use their tools. No evidence indicates Fathom acts as an MCP client or lets users register external MCP servers/tools for its assistant.
